scope: Proposition 3.9 (Properties of the local error ideals) of the manuscript “The trace cone classifies Razak–Jacelon stabilizations” (preprints/The-trace-cone-classifies-Razak-Jacelon-stabilizations-September-25-2026/The-trace-cone-classifies-Razak-Jacelon-stabilizations-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 301 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9cf38a67706f91fa), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The definition of J(U) is independent of representatives and makes it a closed two-sided ideal of D. The assignment is order preserving, and J(U) ⊆ IdealD(Q(U)). (3.14) If ρ is a regularized limit and its restriction σ = ρ|Q is densely finite on Q(U), then ρ|J(U) = 0. (3.15) All assertions use the same conventions in finite matrix algebras.
